content: Yulu Wambarae Yaki Nyuo Kaepala Anatu Suu Pyao Karalapape

Koraisa yanengena randa andake neyamo doko nakama keta sela epara lyakande doko doŋo mona kuki palyuo karalapape. Api mendeme yanenge dokona randa nyera ramo doko Satane kata rekya lao epo kararasa pira.
Wamba yulu koo wangu lakapala pyulu pyuo pyuo kareyami dupwa epapu kapa kaepala Anatunya pii laramuli pyuo pipape.

See nange wambu dupwame pundame kumapala, enda kepo pyuo, biya nao kyakapala, pati andake dupwana piso yuu kwuapala nenge renge nao ipwa koo porai dupwa napala Anatu dokona kaeyapala bange kingimi wasisi dupwa kingi lao karaminyi yulu dopale pyuo kareyami.
Nakama opetae wambo dokopa mee langa dopa pyuo male male lao kareyaminyisa Kurisene ingya nange dupwa akipamo epapu namwa role pyao pii nalyamisi lao see napala kilya kando letaminyi.
Anatumi wambu kumasi letepe kote lara dokopa nakama apa pyuo kareyama lao renge polo lamairami ingilyamo.

Dopa pilyamo dokona waili pii keyange doko kumasi wambu dupwa polo lamaiyapya. Nakama isa yuunya karo dokopa yulu koo piyaminyisa Anatumi nakama kando kote leya. Doko nakama waili pii keyange sepala enakana imambu ingyuo Anatu yale kararami dokonasa polo lamaiya.
Anatumi Mora Petengena Renge Keyange Jiyamo Dupwa Isa Pakami Nana
Yuu lumwa pira doko repe ingilyamo dokona emba range kame pyuo minyuo mona paliramopa karo ateŋa lalapape.
Yulu mupwa minyarami doko wambu yango mona reto karalapape. Mona retarami renge keyange dokome nakamana yulu koo dupwa yambe pyakara ingilyamo.
Nakama mumu laa nao yango sukusa anda epena lao nenge pyuo pisipwape.
Anatumi nakama range wakale wakale keta mora petenge renge jiyamo dupwa mendali keta pisa pisa pyuo maiyalapape. Dokome Anatunya renge keyange dupwa isa pakami nara.

Mendeme misi lara ramo doko baa Anatunya pii doko lena. Mendeme mende nyisara ramo doko Anatumi porai renge maiyamo doko nyepala nyiso pyuo karenale. Yesu Koraisa neta renge ingyuo karalu karenge doko keta yulu peparae pirami ramo Anatunya kingi ketae pyambwaramisa pira.
Kurisene Yulu Dokona Randa Nyerami
Nambana puu minyingimoo. Randa wakale wakale nakama keta epelyamo dupwa nakama apiyakale lao mee makande pyuo ipyamosa pilyamo dokona mona nembo yamarangwa nalapape.
Nakama Koraisana randa nyiyamo dokona mendeke ingyuo nyimwasa pilyamoŋo lao rae maiyuo karalapape. Banya neta renge yulu doko neta epo panaramo dokopa raeme kumuo kararami lyakande.
Nakama Koraisana kimbu moko minyingi dokona reke lao randa nao karamano lao suu pyapala rae maiyuo pupwape. Dopa pyuo pwuamo doko Anatunya Imambu neta renge dokome nakama keta epo paleyasa piya.
Nakama mendeme wambu yango pyao kumakaope waa naope mata kando laope yulu koo dokore pipala randa nyerami doko kapa ingya nalyamo.
Kurisene ingilyaminyi dokona lao randa narami ramo doko elya napala Koraisana lao nyilyuŋu lao Anatu ange lamailapape.

Kote andake laramo yuu gii repetale pyaka sepelyamo dokopa Anatu banya wambu dupwa kando wambowana ingyuo kote lara ingilyamo dokona waili pii keyange doko kinyi lao suu pyaa nange wambu dupwa apa pyuo parami?
Dokona ingyuo buku Baepole dokona pii mende palamo.

content.text: Doko Anatumi rolae pingi dupwa randa nawali
lete wai pyao nyera ramo doko,
wambu kamba lenge koo pingipi dupwa

content: Randa jerami ramo doko Anatu letamuli pyuo nyilyuŋu lao suu pyapala yulu keyange dupwa kaeya nao pyuo karalapape. Yuu muu dupwa wasiyamo Anatu doko pii lamana palya nange dokona range pyamalyuo karalapape.
